Children : Oedema in heart failure and in ascites , nephrotic syndrome, ( Use in reduction of hypokalemia induced by diuretics or amphotericin is not recommended ) : Neonates, 1-2mg/kg daily in 1-2 divided doses, upto 7mg/kg daily in resistant ascites ; 1 mnth-12yr, 1-3mg/kg daily in 1-2 divided doses; upto 9mg/kg daily in resistant ascites; 12-18yr, 50-100mg daily in 1-2 divided doses, upto 9mg/kg daily ( max 400mg daily ) in resistant ascites. OR As directed by your physician.
products.precautions: It should be used with caution in patients with impaired hepatic function because minor alterations of fluid and electrolyte balance may precipitate hepatic coma.
